name: tower_of_hanoi_benchmark_full_50
description: A benchmark collection of Tower of Hanoi problem instances and agent trajectories intended to evaluate planning and sequential decision-making capability. It measures an agent's ability to produce valid move sequences and reach goal states across a set of problem instances. Useful for testing search, planning, and reinforcement learning approaches on an algorithmic reasoning task.
reputation: Provided by the MultiRL collection and used in RL/planning research; moderately recognized in research circles focused on algorithmic benchmarks.
